sources.use: Check impersonation success and token access rights; a failed call must not continue with elevated authority.
Restore the thread identity; terminate the owned test process if restoration fails.
A root handle supplies a relative namespace; this documentation alone is not proof of caller access under impersonation.
Separate permission-setting and inheritance behavior from creation/owner admission.
Next implementation candidate: native descriptor derives original token owner/group without bypassing native owner validation; not implemented or accepted by this experiment.
Next implementation must explicitly prove any required scoped backup/restore privilege and original-owner private reopen; no ACL relaxation or automatic privilege assumption.

decision: Measure the actual canonical create_private behavior before selecting the ownership bridge. Do not infer protected creation rights solely from a directory handle.
